reviews.title: Lebara blocks PAC code
reviews.body:
I switched to Lebara on 16th September on 5G plan for £1.96 per month. What looked like an amazing deal turned into the nightmare.
My data disappeared within a very short period. This has never happened with other providers, especially that I use WI-Fi at work and at home.

I would like to leave Lebara but I am unable to generate the PAC code.
Their online portal throws an "error processing request" message, the app refuses to accept valid verification text codes, and texting 65075 returns an "invalid short code" network error.
I called customer service to request the PAC code to be generated manually, but was told they cannot do it over the phone.
I logged a formal complaint on Wednesday 7th October, and customer service promised a resolution within 48 hours. That deadline has passed, and nothing has been fixed. I called today and was told that team will call me by the end of the day to discuss it. 
Under Ofcom General Condition C7, mobile networks are legally required to provide a PAC code within 2 hours and cannot withhold it due to internal technical failures.
This is the worst provider I have ever been with. Avoid at all cost!!!
